title: Keeping a current copy of the Massachusetts List of Interchangeable Drugs on the pharmacy premises
subtopic: Interchangeable drug reference on the premises
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.19(1)(a) a pharmacy shall maintain on the pharmacy premises a current copy or electronic version of the Massachusetts List of Interchangeable Drugs, including the Orange Book, Additional List, Exception List. Under 247 CMR 9.19(24) the requirement of 247 CMR 9.19(1)(a) does not apply to institutional sterile compounding pharmacies.
exam_relevance: Tests that the list on which interchange depends must be kept current on the premises, as a copy or an electronic version, and that it includes the Orange Book, the Additional List and the Exception List.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy, pharmacy operation

exceptions: Under 247 CMR 9.19(24) the requirement does not apply to institutional sterile compounding pharmacies.
common_confusions: Keeping the Orange Book alone. The copy includes the Orange Book, the Additional List and the Exception List.
Assuming a paper copy is required. The regulation accepts a current copy or an electronic version.
verification_notes: Read in the current 247 CMR 9.00 published on mass.gov (page footers dated 12/6/24) on 2026-09-16, including the exclusions in 247 CMR 9.19(23) and (24).
